column1: I am proud to work for Intel.
I would recommend Intel as a great place to work.
My job makes good use of my skills/strengths.
I have the flexibility to balance the needs of my work and personal life.
I would like to be working at Intel one year from now.
I feel comfortable talking about issues and concerns with management.
In my business group, innovation and creative thinking are actively encouraged.
In my work group, management proactively seeks out opportunities to promote diversity within the workforce.
In 2014, we revised several OHS questions. We have provided alternate data to provide additional context. In 2013, we did not conduct an Organizational Health Survey.
